source: Sverige i fokus, chapter 5: Lag och rätt (extra draft)
questionSv: Vad säger förbudet mot retroaktiv strafflag i Sverige?
questionEn: What does the ban on retroactive criminal law mean in Sweden?
options: Ingen kan dömas för en gärning som inte var brottslig när den begicks.
Straffet bestäms alltid enligt de lagar som gäller när domen faller.
Riksdagen får införa lagar som gäller bakåt i tiden för brott.
Förbudet gäller bara brott mot grundlagar, inte vanlig lag.
optionsEn: No one can be convicted for an act that was not criminal when it was committed.
The penalty is always decided according to the laws in force when the judgment is issued.
The Riksdag may introduce laws that apply backwards in time to crimes.
The ban only applies to crimes against constitutional laws, not ordinary law.
explanationEn: The ban on retroactive criminal law means no one can be punished for an act that was not a crime when committed. Parliament cannot enact laws that apply backwards to criminalize past conduct.
